messages.en: What are you doing!!!
I'm off to work hard now~
The weather is so nice,
it made me think of you, so I messaged you.
I think I look pretty today~
I want to show you.
But I can't show you today, so instead...
This was from the day I went to an event~
It had been a while since I did an event,
so it was really exciting.
Now event season is starting again.
I did two events that day too,
but honestly, rather than being exhausting,
events are just really fun.
But anyway,
What do you think of me without bangs?
Lately my bangs keep separating,
so I think sweeping them aside looks prettier,
so that's how I've been styling them.
But everyone says both styles look good,
so I'll just do whatever I want.
ㅎ
Here's a spoiler:
Today's Hayeon also doesn't have bangs~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
You still don't know what I'm doing though.ㅋㅋㅋ
"What does a magical girl even do?"
Maybe it's a chaotic, cute series about an over-the-top magical girl casting spells.
I still need to get used to it myself.
I'm not really used to magic yet... 핳하
Don't the members tease you at the dorm?
They do tease me,
but it's more like this...
Whenever something happens,
"Hey, you're the magical girl, so use some magic already."
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It's basically like that.
Even the staff,
when they call me,
"Magical girl~"
"You can fly over here, right?"
That's what they say.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Like you can actually fly?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
So the joke has gone this far now?
I'm really looking forward to Badge War.
It looks like it's going to be so much fun, what do I do!!!!!!!!!!
My stage has opened.
Everyone's going to be surprised. ㅋ
Wow, there isn't a single cloud in the sky.
It's so clear.
Just like my eyes.

messages.ko: 나도 대나무 헬리콥터로 하늘을 나는 상상을 하곤해
messages.en: I sometimes imagine flying through the sky with a bamboo helicopter.
That's way too childlike.
I don't really have those kinds of childish fantasies.

messages.ko: 난 굉장히 영양가있는 상상을 하는편이랄까 ㅎㅎ
messages.en: I'd say my imagination is much more... meaningful. ㅎㅎ
This reminds me of that. ㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Like someone who talks very specifically in their sleep.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
"I'm someone who can't feel emotions," or something.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: sns를 얼마나 보는건지 감도 안온다 진짜
messages.en: I seriously can't even imagine how much time you spend on social media.
If you don't want to fall behind the times, you've got to keep up with the trends.

messages.ko: 눈 깜빡하면 두쫀쿠 가고 버터떡 온다니까
messages.en: The moment you blink, Ddujjonku is gone and Butter Rice Cake is the new trend.
So what's coming after Butter Rice Cake?
Hayeon, of course~
ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
May I
write a poem for you?
On this clear day without a single cloud in the sky,

messages.ko: 해가 중천이고 달은 저 멀리에 있는 지금
messages.en: with the sun high overhead and the moon far away,
I instinctively realized
that tonight's dinner would be soy sauce marinated crab.
Soy sauce crab poem, Hayeon version—ta-da!
Wow, I'm almost tearing up.
It's so touching. ㅠ
The crab probably cried too...
It probably shed soy sauce instead...ㅜ
It slowly soaked in...
The crab has a family too...
Crabs actually eat their own babies.
Seriously.
I saw it in a documentary before going to bed!!
They were just picking them out
like it was a buffet. It was shocking.
Do crabs peel the meat before eating too? ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Yeah, and they even dip it in sesame oil before eating. 😌
Looks like crabs have discovered the taste of crab too. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
"Do YOU know the taste of crab?!?"
I'm heading to my schedule now.
Have a wonderful Hayeon-filled day.
Haranghae, y/n. ❤️
